thought.text: The gitignored Laravel cache dirs are absent from checkout. Creating the standard Laravel directory structure, then re-running composer install.

reasoning_content: The storage subdirectories (cache, sessions, views) and bootstrap/cache are gitignored, so they don't exist in the checkout. I need to create these directories and .gitkeep files. This is standard Laravel setup. Let's create them.

action.command: cd /workspace && mkdir -p bootstrap/cache storage/framework/cache/data storage/framework/sessions storage/framework/views storage/app/public storage/app/private && chmod -R 775 bootstrap/cache storage && composer install --no-interaction 2>&1 | tail -8; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
